Name: Eggs-otic Creatures
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[size=3]This mod was hatched from a conversation between several folks in the SDV Discord Server. What started as a fun little exercise to give our friend Ben new hats to wear became this fully functional coop animal mod. 

These Eggies live in a coop and never get hungry. In return for pats, they'll find various useful items for you. The stronger the friendship, the greater the rewards![/size]

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/b1fb7l.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Adds 6 new "varieties" of hat-wearing Eggie creatures: Forager Egg, Farmer Egg, Prospector Egg, Buff Egg, Uncanny Egg, and a Super Special Rare Egg. Each Eggie will have a randomly assigned hat - there are 22 different ones in total. [/size]
[/list][size=3] - ﻿Hats are randomly assigned when the Eggie hatches.
﻿ ﻿- Each variety of Eggie has a focus on different types of items:
﻿ ﻿ ﻿* [u]Forager Eggies:[/u] Will produce season-specific forage 
﻿ ﻿ ﻿* [u]Farmer Eggies:[/u] Will produce different seasonal crops and seeds
﻿ ﻿ ﻿* [u]Prospector Eggies:[/u] Will produce different ores, gems, and minerals
﻿ ﻿ ﻿* [u]Buff Eggies:[/u] Will produce various cooking dishes that have beneficial buffs
﻿ ﻿ ﻿* [u]Uncanny Eggies:[/u] Will produce various "magical" items
﻿ ﻿ ﻿* [u]Super Special Rare Eggie[/u]: Will produce rare items

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b][i]Players MUST have either a Big Coop or a Deluxe Coop built[/i][/b] - Eggies cannot be purchased, they can only be hatched from an incubator.  [img]https://files.catbox.moe/3snmaa.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Eggies are hatched from EggNodes - the first EggNode is a gift from Marnie. As you progress in friendship, Eggies will drop the next level of EggNode.[/size]
[*][size=3]Once players reach a certain number of regular chicken eggs laid, Marnie will sell EggNodes.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://files.catbox.moe/7a7fhz.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Download this mod and unzip into your /Mods folder.
[*]Can be used on new and existing saves.
[/list]
[b][u][size=4]CONFIGURATION[/size][/u][/b][list]
[*][size=3]There is one configuration option, to choose whether EggNodes are added to the shipping collection (required for perfection). This is ON by default. To change, navigate to the Mod Options menu in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿, find "Eggsotic Creatures" and uncheck the box.[/size]
[*][size=3]You [i]can[/i] edit the config.json manually, but installing GMCM is strongly recommended. [/size]
[/list]

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/x4nzqr.png[/img]﻿
